statements.label: Theorem 1
statements.restatement: d=1, b>1, 0<a<1/b, p>=b, 0<j<=1, e>=bj/(b-j), 0<=c<Crat: G(0,p,j,c,e,1,b,a) > 0, G the 965-term T_65 radial octic. Pure algebraic inequality.

statements.label: six-ray capacity claim
statements.restatement: c >= Crat is safe for every p,e>0 via the six-ray Gram family at t = eta e/(D0+eta^2 e), with c*(t) = Crat, p*(t) < p.

outside region (c = 1.01,2,10 Crat): 14 of 1200 points have G<0, so the bound is not vacuous
